purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
The WM-ACT-028 parent signal and every neighboring edge remain provisional rather than canonical.
Campaign, revision, wave, flight, activity, placement, communication and interaction identities remain separate.
Audience definition, eligibility, selection, addressability, reach, engagement, response, conversion, lead, opportunity and customer states remain separate and source qualified.
Objective, target, hypothesis, metric definition, observation, attribution and causal effect remain separate assertions.
Purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection, suppression and channel permission remain jurisdiction and purpose scoped.
Planned, approved, allocated, committed, incurred and actual budget or cost remain separate from contracts, invoices, payments and ledgers.
TM Forum access limitations and the TMF699 release-label inconsistency remain explicit.
Every external projection remains release-pinned, profile-qualified and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The marketing-campaign aggregate boundary is coherent and does not absorb party, audience, consent, offer, promotion, advertisement, creative, activity, communication, placement, finance, observation, experiment, sales or records masters.
Campaign state never proves delivery, impression, viewability, reach, response, conversion, revenue or business outcome.
Attribution remains model-relative and is not treated as proof of causality.
Audience evidence preserves criteria, source, purpose, recency, exclusions, fairness controls and prohibited-attribute boundaries.
Budget and cost evidence preserves amount type, currency, approval state, time and authoritative source.
Privacy and direct-marketing controls preserve jurisdiction, purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection, suppression and channel-permission distinctions.

Autonomous protected-group targeting, unlawful contact, consent creation, sensitive inference, dark patterns, discrimination, publishing, media purchase, budget commitment, disclosure and destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
